title: `SpatialData.data`
text: SpatialData.data package incorporates dummy-spatialdata python package (https://pypi.org/project/dummy-spatialdata/) via basilisk generate toy spatialdata objects multiple spatialdata versions. Now can read SpatialData object SpatialData. can also get individual elements
code: sd_zarr <- generate_dataset(   sd_version = "0.5.0",   images = list(     list(type = "rgb", scale_factors = c(2L,2L,2L), coordinate_system="global"),     list(type = "grayscale", n_layers = c(), coordinate_system="global")   ),   shapes = list(     list(n=12L, type="polygon", coordinate_system="global")   ),   points = list(     list(n=12L)   ),   coordinate_systems = list(     global = list(       transformations = list("affine"),        shape = list(x=2000L, y=2000L)     )   ) ) sd_zarr ## [1] "/tmp/RtmpBTvSFn/file9c7a7bda4d82.zarr" sd <- readSpatialData(sd_zarr) sd ## class: SpatialData ## - images(2): ##   - image_0 (3,2000,2000) ##   - image_1 (1,2000,2000) ## - labels(0): ## - points(1): ##   - point_0 (12) ## - shapes(1): ##   - shape_0 (12,polygon) ## - tables(0): ## coordinate systems(2): ## - global(3): image_0 image_1 shape_0 ## - point_0(1): point_0 image(sd, 1) ## class: SpatialDataImage (MultiScale)  ## Scales (4): (3,2000,2000 3,1000,1000 3,500,500 3,250,250)

title: SpatialData datasets
text: Spatialdata.data package provides utilities accessing, reading generating SpatialData datasets. Data variety spatial omics technologies made available SpatialData .zarr stores scverse SpatialData examples available Bioc’s NSF OSN bucket scverse’s spatialdata-sandbox (https://spatialdata.scverse.org/en/latest/tutorials/notebooks/datasets/README.html) SpatialData.data uses basilisk interface maintain multiple versions python’s spatialdata package (0.3.0, 0.5.0 0.7.2) reading writing .zarr stores. basilisk environments (0.5.0 0.7.2) also accompanied dummy-spatialdata package generates toy spatialdata examples whose elements customized user.
